title: Recreate ClearPoint Strategy-style marketing website (structure, interactions, and responsive UI)

requirements.text: Build a multi-page marketing website that closely matches the information architecture and UX patterns of https://www.clearpointstrategy.com/ (header navigation, homepage sections, inner pages, footer), using original copy and assets (no proprietary text/images copied from the reference site).

quotes: create a website exactly like this https://www.clearpointstrategy.com/ and give me the output

acceptanceCriteria: Top-level navigation includes a logo area, primary nav links, and clear calls-to-action similar in placement/behavior to the reference site (e.g., a primary CTA button in the header).
Site includes at least: Home, Platform/Product (or equivalent), Services/Solutions (or equivalent), Resources (blog/articles listing + detail page), About, and Contact pages.
All page layouts are responsive across mobile/tablet/desktop with no horizontal overflow and no broken layouts.
All user-facing text is in English and is original (not copied from the reference site).

requirements.text: Implement the homepage with clear, scroll-based sections comparable to the reference site’s homepage (hero, social proof, feature/value sections, benefits, testimonials/case studies preview, resources preview, and final CTA band), including appropriate spacing, typography hierarchy, and section transitions.

quotes: create a website exactly like this https://www.clearpointstrategy.com/ and give me the output

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage renders a hero section with headline, subheadline, primary CTA, secondary CTA, and a prominent hero visual.
Homepage includes a social-proof/logo strip section.
Homepage includes at least 3 feature/value cards and at least 1 testimonial/case-study style section.
Homepage includes a resources preview section linking to the resources listing page.
Homepage includes a final CTA section above the footer.

requirements.text: Create a Resources area that supports listing content cards and viewing a content detail page, with client-side routing and consistent templates (title, summary, cover image, body content, author/date, and related items).

quotes: create a website exactly like this https://www.clearpointstrategy.com/ and give me the output

acceptanceCriteria: Resources listing page shows a grid/list of content cards with cover image, title, short excerpt, and metadata.
Clicking a content card navigates to a detail page with full body content and a consistent layout.
At least 6 sample resources are included as seed content (original text).
Routes work with refresh (direct navigation to a detail URL loads correctly).

requirements.text: Add a Contact page with a form (name, email, company/organization, message) and clear success/error states. Persist form submissions in the Motoko backend and expose a read API for later retrieval.

quotes: create a website exactly like this https://www.clearpointstrategy.com/ and give me the output

acceptanceCriteria: Contact form validates required fields and email format on the client.
On submit, the frontend calls the backend to store the submission and shows a success confirmation state.
Backend stores submissions in stable state (survives canister upgrade).
Backend provides at least: createSubmission and listSubmissions endpoints; listSubmissions is not exposed in the UI by default (API only).

requirements.text: Implement site-wide UI polish similar to the reference site: consistent section widths, large-type marketing typography, hover/focus states, accessible contrast, and light motion (e.g., subtle fade/slide-in on scroll) without harming performance.

quotes: create a website exactly like this https://www.clearpointstrategy.com/ and give me the output

acceptanceCriteria: Interactive elements (links, buttons, cards) have clear hover and focus-visible states.
Motion is subtle and respects reduced-motion preferences.
Lighthouse-like best practices are followed: no blocking mega-assets; images are optimized and appropriately sized.
All primary pages have consistent max-width, spacing scale, and typography scale.

requirements.text: Apply a creative, coherent visual theme suitable for a modern B2B strategy/software marketing site (avoid a blue/purple-dominant palette). Define and use a consistent system for colors, typography, buttons, cards, and section backgrounds across all pages.

quotes: create a website exactly like this https://www.clearpointstrategy.com/ and give me the output

acceptanceCriteria: A consistent theme is applied across all pages (same button styles, heading styles, spacing, and card styles).
Primary palette is not blue/purple-dominant; use an alternative (e.g., charcoal/off-white with green/teal accents).
Typography hierarchy is clear (H1/H2/H3/body) and consistent across pages.

requirements.text: Add basic SEO and social metadata for all primary routes (title, description, OpenGraph image) and ensure accessible semantics (landmarks, headings, alt text for images).

quotes: create a website exactly like this https://www.clearpointstrategy.com/ and give me the output

acceptanceCriteria: Each primary page sets a unique title and meta description.
OpenGraph tags are present and reference a generated OG image asset.
All images have appropriate alt text; pages use semantic headings and landmarks (header/nav/main/footer).

requirements.text: Deliver the complete runnable project output (frontend + Motoko backend) so the site can be built and deployed as-is on the Internet Computer template environment.

quotes: create a website exactly like this https://www.clearpointstrategy.com/ and give me the output

acceptanceCriteria: Project builds successfully without manual edits.
Navigation between pages works in the deployed environment.
Contact form submission works end-to-end (frontend to backend).

constraints: Do not copy proprietary text, images, or other copyrighted assets from https://www.clearpointstrategy.com/; use original copy and newly generated visuals while matching the overall structure and interaction patterns.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo); only add backend/migration.mo if stable-state migration is required.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose them instead.
No third-party auth providers; only Internet Identity is allowed if authentication is later needed (not required for this request).
nonGoals: Implementing a full CMS/editor for managing resources content.
Integrating third-party marketing tools (analytics pixels, chat widgets, email delivery providers).
Cloning exact brand identity assets (logos, illustrations, photography) from the reference site.

Row of 6 generic partner logos in monochrome style (partner-logos-strip.dim_1600x200.png)
Set of 6 simple outline feature icons (feature-icons-set.dim_1024x1024.png)
Testimonial portrait placeholders (3 headshots, neutral background) (testimonials-headshots.dim_900x300.png)
OpenGraph preview image with abstract shapes and title-safe area (og-image.dim_1200x630.png)
